name: Scenario 1: Cold Start Novel Outage
description: First time occurrence of Redis memory exhaustion on payment-service with no prior Hindsight memory.

payload.message: PaymentService pods undergoing OOMKilled evictions in prod-eu-west-1. Error rate elevated to 14.8%.
payload.raw_logs: FATAL 2026-11-05T10:14:02Z [payment-service-78f99] OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space. Redis connection thread dump: 250 threads blocked on eviction buffer.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: Redis cache eviction policy set to noeviction under flash traffic
resolution.resolution_summary: Applied config update: maxmemory-policy volatile-lru and expanded cluster RAM to 8GB
resolution.lessons_learned: Never allow noeviction policy in production caching tiers.
